g.title: df-001: Unauthenticated HTTP requests (page load, API, public routes) (HTTP) df-004: Authenticated REST API requests (basket, orders, profile, challenges) (HTTP) df-005: Angular SPA REST API calls via HTTP interceptor with JWT bearer token (HTTP) df-001 authentication: Public routes; no receiving login check; evidence: server.ts:606, server.ts:607 df-001 access group: Account / product requests; alternatives; step n/a df-004 authentication: JWT check on the protected REST subset, not every API route; evidence: server.ts:356, server.ts:358, lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-004 access group: Account / product requests; alternatives; step n/a df-005 authentication: JWT check on the protected REST subset, not every API route; evidence: server.ts:356, server.ts:358, lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-005 access group: Account / product requests; alternatives; step n/a

df-002: User login with email and password credentials (HTTP) df-003: Second-factor verification for enrolled accounts (HTTP) df-002 authentication: Email/password check; enrolled users continue to the second factor; evidence: routes/login.ts:34, routes/login.ts:37 df-002 access group: Credentials (MFA if enrolled); sequence; step 1 df-003 authentication: Enrolled accounts: password-verified temporary token followed by TOTP; transport deployment is unverified; evidence: routes/login.ts:37, routes/2fa.ts:20, routes/2fa.ts:31 df-003 access group: Credentials (MFA if enrolled); sequence; step 2

df-006: Socket.IO real-time bidirectional event channel (Socket.IO) df-006 authentication: Socket.IO connection and event handlers have no separate login check; evidence: lib/startup/registerWebsocketEvents.ts:20, lib/startup/registerWebsocketEvents.ts:23

df-007: Sequelize ORM queries to SQLite database (user data, challenges, orders) (SQLite in-process) df-007 authentication: Embedded SQLite file access; no database-server login, filesystem permissions remain separate; evidence: models/index.ts:33, models/index.ts:34, models/index.ts:41

df-008: User credential lookup and session data persistence (SQLite in-process) df-008 authentication: Embedded SQLite file access; no database-server login, filesystem permissions remain separate; evidence: models/index.ts:33, models/index.ts:34, models/index.ts:41
df-009: LLM inference HTTP request to Ollama on port 11434 (HTTP)
df-013: MFA settings (HTTP) df-013 authentication: JWT-protected status/setup/disable; handlers also check operation-specific credentials; evidence: server.ts:463, server.ts:467, server.ts:473
df-014: Wallet / NFT (HTTP) df-014 authentication: No mandatory session on the Web3 routes; wallet input is not proof of key possession; evidence: server.ts:641, server.ts:644
df-015: Reviews / orders (MarsDB in-process) df-015 authentication: Embedded collection calls; no database-server login; evidence: data/mongodb.ts:9, data/mongodb.ts:10
df-016: Chain events (WSS) df-016 authentication: Configured provider API key in the WSS URL; deployment may leave it unset; evidence: routes/nftMint.ts:18, routes/web3Wallet.ts:20
